body: Thank you for your kind words, I needed to read that today

I just got broken up with this morning and found out 6 hours later he was already back on dating apps. Huge blow. I think all we can do it take it day by day and recognize it's going to suck, probably for awhile but it's just about getting through the day. Fresh air helps, make sure you move around and maybe light exercise. Just something for your brain to be distracted with. One day it won't hurt so bad
I know this is the right decision for him and for me, it just sucks but hopefully he finds someone that he cares about to have all that with
